cellar_rats.name: Cellar Pack
cellar_rats.intro: Soft claws scrape the flagstones behind the barrels. Then another set answers, and another — the patter of small rodents racing toward you through the dark. Red eyes blink awake between the casks. The cellar exhales musk and hunger as the pack pours out across the floor.
cellar_rats.outro: The last rat twitches and lies still. In the sudden quiet you can hear the cellar breathe, and something glints between the vessels on the far wall.

hole_rats.name: Threshold Hole — Rats
hole_rats.notes: Oneshot: after 1st side room / first seal.
hole_rats.intro: From the threshold hole comes a hurried scratching — claws on stone, closer with every breath. Dust and fur cough up from the dark. Two giant rats scramble into the corridor, starving and furious that you are standing in their way.
hole_rats.outro: The rats go limp at the edge of the hole. Whatever is feeding them down there is still awake.

well_centipedes.name: Well Noise — Centipedes
well_centipedes.intro: From the throat of the well, strange chittering rises — wet, many-legged, and always closer. The pulley shrieks. A rustle of a hundred legs climbs the stones, and glossy mandibles crest the rim.
well_centipedes.outro: The centipedes curl and fall back into the well. The echo of their legs takes a long time to stop.

hole_centipedes.name: Threshold Hole — Centipedes
hole_centipedes.intro: Burnt hair and a dry clicking climb from the hole, the sound growing nearer until it fills the corridor. Giant centipedes spill over its rim, mandibles wet and searching.
hole_centipedes.outro: The centipedes lie in a tangle of legs. The rim of the hole is warm to the touch.

lab_infernal_spider.name: Infernal Spider
lab_infernal_spider.intro: Something shifts in the rafters — silk whispering, closer. Embers drip like molten glass. The ceiling moves as the Infernal Spider unfolds, eight burning eyes fixed on you. This is the thing that has been poisoning the brew. [[spider: You drank from my nest, little brewers. Now I drink from you.]]
lab_infernal_spider.outro: [[spider: My silk… my children…]] The Infernal Spider shrieks, and its fire gutters out. It folds in on itself and crashes to the laboratory floor. The silk goes dark all at once.

corridor_magma_rat.name: Magma Rat Ambush
corridor_magma_rat.intro: Heat blooms under the mosaic. Something heavy scrapes closer through the orange glow — claws, then a hiss of steam. A rat the size of a pony drags itself out of the heat, fur smoking, lava dripping from its jaws. The exit tax has come due. [[magma_rat: Mmm. Heroes, lightly roasted.]]
corridor_magma_rat.outro: The Magma Rat hisses one last cloud of steam and cools into black stone. The way up to the brewery is clear.
